cross_module.how: EXEC CICS LINK via CARDSVC.PGM_ROUTE row XMOD/RISKSVC -> PRKYC01 (CALL_TYPE 'L', fallback CACRD92), issued by the CACRD90 dispatcher
cross_module.why: authorisation risk assessment crosses into PARTYRSK at run time; no CARDSVC source names the target, only the seeded control table does (db2/ddl/40_SEED_PGM_ROUTE.sql:33)

cross_module.how: EXEC CICS LINK via CARDSVC.PGM_ROUTE row XMOD/KYCINQ -> PRKYC03 (CALL_TYPE 'L', fallback CACRD92)
cross_module.why: the party/KYC inquiry screen of CA00 is served by PARTYRSK code

cross_module.how: dynamic CALL via CARDSVC.PGM_ROUTE row XMOD/RSKRECAL -> PRBRSK1 (CALL_TYPE 'D')
cross_module.why: batch exposure recalculation entry point; which CARDSVC batch step reaches it is for dynamic-call-resolution to prove (BINDCARD.jcl:264 keeps PRTYCOLL in the CARDNITP PKLIST for one CARDNITE step)

cross_module.how: EXEC SQL SELECT FROM CARDSVC.ACCOUNT / CARDSVC.CARD_LIMIT
cross_module.why: PARTYRSK reads the live card balances and limits in CARDDB directly (legacy cross-database grants); the two databases cannot move separately

cross_module.how: DB2 plans bind both collections: CARDONLP/CARDNITP PKLIST(CARDCOLL.*, PRTYCOLL.*), PRTYONLP/PARTYWKP PKLIST(PRTYCOLL.*, CARDCOLL.*)
cross_module.why: each module runs the other's packages under its own plans
